detail.longDescription: Guys, I'm preparing PH4NTXM Ghost Edition Theme. It's a white-pearl theme for PH4NTXM, so you can have the choice to build it based on your preferences, dark or bright look. It changes the whole experience based on the edition you'll choose, from boot to desktop. Users that prefer a darker underground aesthetic can choose "midnight", and users that are more into clean bright colors can use the "ghost" parameters, that will produce the bright edition of PH4NTXM. # ph4ntxm # linux # debian # os # live # privacy # security # opsec # infosec # research # tech # technology
